summary: Re-pin after the rebase onto #940's merge. A rebase voids the pin, so this is a fresh review at the exact head, never a re-stamp. Ancestor property checked with the gate's own test first: base 9b82d51e IS an ancestor of head 80f4501f. CODEX-2's 'preserved identical diffs' CLAIM VERIFIED, NOT ACCEPTED: I diffed the old range 55f1c61d..0c4cabbd against the new range 9b82d51e..80f4501f, ignoring index lines, and they are byte-identical (100 lines each). My prior verification at 0c4cabbd therefore carries in full, and I re-ran the parts that could still drift: 19 focused tests pass on the rebased tree, and the mutation still bites — reverting display_name to 'Schwab 1 Min Bot v2 (isolated)' turns test_atr_and_orb_use_operator_names_without_changing_their_routes RED. The single commit carries exactly one recognised agent marker. Substance unchanged and re-affirmed: literal label strings rather than a constant compared to itself (the ORBLBL trap), and the routes a rename most endangers are pinned — account_name stays live:schwab_1m_v2 and paper:orb, with execution_mode=paper and provider=none. Broker-account safety was verified earlier on the deployed box with the REAL service env (configured_broker_account_registrations returns live:orb and the Webull adapter resolves it), which is the check that matters because a bare Settings() gave me a false 'account missing' reading. THIS PIN COMMIT ALSO DELETES THE SUPERSEDED RECORD at records/0c4cabbd.../pr-942--55f1c61d...--claude-1.json: that head is orphaned by the rebase, it covers no merged commit, and the gate globs records/*/pr-942--*.json across EVERY head directory — leaving it would fail-close this PR in CI while still passing a local verify, which is exactly what bit #934 yesterday.
